task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a pale, smooth tissue surface with fine branching red vasculature occupying the upper right, adjacent to a dark shadowed region on the left. The camera slowly pans and tilts, revealing more of the underlying tissue which appears moist, glistening, and slightly translucent with a network of small blood vessels. A small, bright specular highlight is visible on the tissue surface. As the view shifts, a darker, more textured area with denser, finer vascular patterns becomes visible in the lower left, contrasting with the smoother, more brightly lit tissue in the upper right. The lighting is warm and yellowish, typical of laparoscopic illumination, creating strong contrast between the illuminated tissue and the deep shadows. The overall scene is static with only minor camera adjustments, focusing on the texture and vascular details of the internal anatomy.
